The Residence

Embrace the serenity of lush greenery — clean lines and purposeful design, seamlessly merged.

OAKA Residences rises as two 30-storey blocks of just 175 homes each, on freehold land along Jalan Jalil Perkasa 7. Within your secure haven, OAKA provides an array of dynamic amenities and facilities, delivering boundless experiences.

Every home comes with a storage/utility room and a balcony or lanai; selected layouts feature convertible spaces with hackable walls and both dry & wet kitchens. Experience the epitome of serenity — and bring your pets along, too.

Good to Know

Frequently asked questions

OAKA Residences sits at Lot 36471, Jalan Jalil Perkasa 7, Bukit Jalil, 57100 Kuala Lumpur — within walking distance of Awan Besar and Sri Petaling LRT stations, with direct access to KESAS, MEX, Bukit Jalil Highway, KL–Seremban and Sungai Besi expressways. Pavilion Bukit Jalil is 2.4 km away.

OAKA is a freehold condominium and prices are updated regularly with launch packages and rebates. For the latest price list and the best available units, message us on WhatsApp or leave your details above — we'll send the current pricing and floor plans to you directly.

Four layouts: Type A (882 sq ft, 2BR/2BA), Type B1 (1,182 sq ft, 2+1BR with hackable wall), Type B3 (1,175 sq ft, 2+1BR with lanai) and Type C (1,423 sq ft, 3BR/3BA). All units come with a storage/utility room, a balcony or lanai, and 2–3 parking bays.

Yes — OAKA is designed as a pet-friendly community, a rarity among KL condominiums, so your furry family members are welcome too.

The expected date of completion is February 2028. The project reached structural completion with a topping-out ceremony in January 2026, so construction is well on track.

Berjaya Hartanah Berhad (223292-U), a subsidiary of Berjaya Land Berhad. Developer's License No. 5660/01-2028/0354(A); Advertising Permit No. 5660-14/02-2027/0165(A)-(S). The development comprises 350 units — Block A (175) and Block B (175) — and is GreenRE Gold certified.
